entities.name: Actifit with OWHTO
observations: A prospective comparative study of 60 patients found no patient-reported advantage from adding Actifit to OWHTO at mean 31.2 months; WOMET and pain VAS improvement favored OWHTO alone, while IKDC improvement and satisfaction did not differ significantly.
The study was nonrandomized and modest in size; reported abstract provided no comparative imaging outcomes or complication rates, so long-term structural benefit remains undetermined.
